build.note: In-game measurement. Its source side is attachment audit entry (3c) in the site repo's docs/ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md (GS_MRGGA binds GID_ADSTime_MZL_M10 for the three Magnus suppressor packages); the note cites no raw hashes.

question: How long is the Mk 24's hip-to-ADS and ADS-to-hip transition at 120 fps with no muzzle and with each of the Hybrid Suppressor L, S and K (the Mini Flex 1x sight), i.e. does the ADS-time binding GS_MRGGA has for these suppressors show in the game?

sourceFacts.recording: MK24_Hybrid_Suppressor_ADS_Speed.mp4: 2560x1440 h264, 4,050 frames, r_frame_rate 120/1; frame timestamps jittery (median step 8.33 ms, 1st-99th percentile 7.28 to 9.31 ms) plus one 496 ms gap at the file start; extracted with -fps_mode passthrough so frame index = native frame; durations = frames / 120 * 1000 (PTS-based ms differ by under 2 ms). Optic is the Mini Flex 1x reflex (per the operator's correction), so the zoom change is small and the scene signal is dominated by the weapon model moving to or from the centre. The note's folder and scripts (mag.py, trans.py, summ.py, ex_*.png) sat in a session scratchpad (not kept in the repo).
sourceFacts.method: Signal (a), scene/weapon motion: mean absolute difference between consecutive 320x180 frames (dd[i] = frame i against i-1). Start = first frame i with dd[i] > 2.0 and dd[i+1] > 2.0. Strict end (primary) = first frame e with median(dd[e+1..e+6]) < 0.5 and max < 2.0; loose end uses median < 1.0; the p05-p95 variant is first/last frame at 5% / 95% of the way to the settled frame e+10. Signal (b), the magenta spread indicator in a 400x300 centre crop: absent in ADS; hip extent 117 px (None) or about 151 px (L/S/K); hip to ADS it vanishes in a single frame at full hip size 1 to 2 frames after scene start; ADS to hip it appears 3 to 5 frames after scene start at about 31 px and reaches full hip size 21 to 25 frames after scene start. Group boundaries from the muzzle-select menu screens: None frames 246-885, L 1265-1978, S 2342-3037, K 3336-4049.

None.excluded: the third (60 f, 500 ms) overlaps the post-menu exposure fade-in

K.excluded: the 4th transition is cut off by the video end

sourceFacts.ambiguityAndDuplicates: Ambiguous: the None group's first hip>ADS (fade-in overlap, 60 f) and first ADS>hip start (383, just after the fade-in). Strict against loose end differs by 4 to 9 frames; p05-p95 spans differ by up to 4 frames; frame-step quantisation is 8.33 ms; the start frame is exact to +-1 frame. Duplicated frames with dd < 0.005 in game segments: 11 of 2,764 (0.40%); dd < 0.02: 72 (2.6%, mostly static ADS holds); inside the 24 measured transitions no frame with dd < 0.3; packet count 4,050 = ffprobe count, no dropped or repeated timestamps beyond the 496 ms start gap.
sourceFacts.panelContext: From the site repo docs/ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md (3c): operator panels of 17 October show ADS time 250 ms with no muzzle and with each of the three suppressors; the offset from the panel's 250 ms to 333 ms is the settle criterion and is the same in all four muzzle states.

inference: Hip-to-ADS took 40 frames (333 ms by the strict criterion) for None, L, S and K alike (None 40 to 41, S 39 to 40), and ADS-to-hip 35 to 38 frames: no measurable muzzle effect on ADS time even though GS_MRGGA binds an ADS-time package for the three suppressors. This is the site audit's reading (docs/ATTACHMENT_BUGS.md 3c: 'Panel and recording show no effect; no change').
unresolved: Whether the GID_ADSTime_MZL_M10 binding is inactive, neutral or overridden at runtime is not settled by a measurement of the transition (the effect is absent in both the panel and the recording).
Numbers only: the strict, loose and p05-p95 criteria disagree by 4 to 9 frames, so absolute ADS time is a criterion choice; only the equality across muzzles is read from it.
siteImpact: None applied: the site applies no muzzle ADS-time step to the Hybrid Suppressors, and this recording supports leaving it so (attachment audit 3c, 'no change').
